title: Travelling the state without trouble
summary: The band toured Louisiana and slept in railroad stations without trouble.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: We were in good shape. Never was laid on her job. Never had no trouble. Went all through the state of Louisiana. All hours of night, anywhere. Plenty of time we had to sleep in the railroad station. Nobody would go and get a room. Miscuitis used to eat us up. But we never had no trouble. Nobody would ever bother. We went all over the car, the crack of town and everything else. Then we never did bother. We had a job in Central Hotel one night. There wasn't iron colored bands in there. We got in and the people wouldn't let them put us out. That's it. They put these bands out there. After that they sent high.
